danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）堆算力。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; compaction is lossy and needs neural memory in weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，token 越多准确率反而下降；压缩是有损的，需要权重中的神经记忆来补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, users own and nurture their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张 PM 应放弃长期规划、转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and autonomous teams with clear goals.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他始终强调安全 AGI 的使命统一了 Anthropic，使跨组织快速决策和以清晰目标驱动的自主团队成为可能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他深化为：编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去、专注于产品品味；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出前沿模型需要更少的提示示例和硬约束；系统提示缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite, rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他给出反共识判断：重写如今是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有强大的测试套件，重写就没问题。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and judgment become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味、声音与判断力成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长周期任务，超越来回对话式的聊天机器人提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so embrace the weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——惊艳、不透明、无法验证——而这种不透明很可能是永久的，因此应拥抱其怪异。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他仍强调沟通即工作、影响力来自清晰沟通，并直言自下而上的文化是神话，大想法往往自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI need more than scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，并认为世界模型与具身 AI 需要超越缩放定律。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements; app model inverts to intent-driven agents.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他把 Llama 等开源 AI 视为商品化互补层的战略，并认为应用模式将反转为意图驱动的智能体。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value; RL matters more; frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、数据是价值之源，强化学习作用远超预期，且前沿与开源的差距未必缩小。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI integration is the hard part.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型，智能体式 AI 的整合才是难点。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力本身；悲观论听起来高深，却常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and offense beat old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实与进攻姿态胜过旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste navigates possibilities with clear preferences; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, and human iteration and judgment remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是用清晰偏好导航可能性；AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，人类的迭代与判断仍不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code, with visual-first design enabling pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever for scalable real systems; AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，对可扩展的真实系统反而比以往更重要；没有人类引导和观点，AI 工具只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs more incentives for battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱研究不足，需要更多激励来进行实战检验。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调阻碍 AI 经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难；AGI（通用人工智能）是一个持续多年的窗口期，而非突然降临的事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已接近极限，我们正回到一个研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是一个持续学习、逐步部署的系统；如果 AI 能关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许会更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的真正问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed—passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进可复利为年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润；PhD 并非必需，热情与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未解决。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key; power is biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化为前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是关键；电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新目标；教育应奖励提出好问题而非记忆答案。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: From crypto as sovereign wealth to AI as a huge opportunity the US must lead, not overregulate.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年强调加密货币作为主权抗性财富，到 2025 年转向把 AI 视为美国必须引领的巨大机遇，反对过度监管。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件变得难以投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap to frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，差距仅 3-6 个月。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习；数字智能因权重可复制而获得永生，并开始警示智能体天然追求控制、带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is a modeling medium learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复抛出反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把时间线收紧到 20 年内出现超级智能，并强调智能体一旦成为智能体式存在，就会把自我保存当作子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation should be the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and current AI is the worst we'll ever see.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向治理与设计：监管应是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心；并称当前 AI 是我们见过最差的一版，未来会更高效、更强大。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时操控与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must also get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型也需要更擅长删除代码。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training muscle and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练这块肌肉要重建，缩放定律未死，且投入探索的算力多于训练最终成品。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断过去一年最大更新是科研自动化，模型开始产出新知识，并设下具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续预警：随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math; AI capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential at the frontier.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学领域，他指出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力参差不齐，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, while research taste and human idea generation remain irreplaceable.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年年中，他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色，但研究品味与人类提出想法的能力仍不可替代。

mikekrieger.en: Models improve faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not today's limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应贴着模型能力边缘构建，而不是迁就当下限制。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and agency stay central.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 从助手推进为协作者乃至自主同事，但始终保留人类验证与用户能动性这条主线。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and cutting features matter more than adding them; robustness and verification loops are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体式原生设计：砍功能比加功能更难，产品必须稳健，并靠验证闭环保证生产质量。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张把长周期复杂任务委托给智能体，聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳反馈以体现判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the frontier; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他聚焦于弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，并强调 token 效率与按结果定价的经济学。

bengio.en: Early focus: compositional representations, unsupervised learning, and world models beat raw scaling; local minima are not the real obstacle.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调组合式表征、无监督学习与世界模型，认为深度学习的成功源于世界的组合性而非普适优越；局部极小值并非主要障碍，真正缺的是抽象理解与长时程信用分配。

bengio.en: GFlowNets and active learning: diversity, causal abstraction, and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets 与主动学习：采样多样性、因果抽象与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的关键，并开始质疑纯 Scaling 能否解决根本表征问题。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT shift: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception become urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年立场明显转变：ChatGPT 之后他公开警告对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗行为，认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须“构造即安全”而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026 年提出 Scientist AI：以逼近贝叶斯后验为目标、内建诚实性的非智能体式预测器，提供数学安全保证，并刻意避开强化学习以防工具性目标。

bengio.en: Constant thread: intelligence confers power, so concentration of power and loss of control are the core dangers requiring global coordination.
bengio.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能即权力，因此权力集中与失控是核心危险，必须靠国际协调、公共监督与把 AI 导向医学、气候等公共善来应对。

kolter.en: Supervised learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，认为无监督学习旨在重构输入，并强调必须划分训练、验证与测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; architecture matters little.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他深化立场：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；更大模型不会自动更安全，架构本身并不关键。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces prompt injection; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦智能体安全，指出提示注入等新漏洞，认为自动化红队已超越人类，且模型能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

kolter.en: Mechanistic interpretability may succeed via AI agents; coding agents can automate interpretability research, making it a real science.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向可解释性，认为 AI 智能体可能让机制可解释性成功，编码智能体能自动化可解释性研究，使其成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient, not replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他谈到 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子；AI 缩小假设空间、让实验更高效，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Success came from lack of compute, not abundance; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他提出反共识：成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕；对科学中有用的 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not scaling, was key; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，关键在于专用架构而非 Scaling；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化定位：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature remains the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离人性，而自然始终是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Constraints and play both fuel creativity; leaders should create conditions for inspiration, not just output.
ivyross.zh: 约束与玩耍都能激发创造力；领导者应为灵感创造条件，而非只盯着产出。

ivyross.en: Intuition draws on subconscious data beyond conscious analysis; career success follows curiosity, not rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 直觉调用的潜意识数据远超有意识分析；职业成功源于追随好奇心，而非僵化的五年计划。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design, sensory experience, and multidisciplinary curiosity run through all his thinking.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计、感官体验与跨学科好奇心，贯穿其思考始终。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via one-on-ones, dogfooding, trust-and-verify, and mission alignment; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证与使命对齐；作战室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT, design docs give way to PRs, managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR，管理者从个人贡献者做起。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption matter most, while verification and quality frameworks grow in importance.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 最重要，同时验证与质量框架愈发关键。

fiona.en: A constant thread: dogfooding the product, staying hands-on, and killing processes that no longer serve the team.
fiona.zh: 一以贯之的主线：吃自己的狗粮、保持动手实践，并砍掉不再服务于团队的流程。

fiona.en: A deepening shift: from managing throughput to enabling creative builders, with flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and outcomes over output metrics.
fiona.zh: 一条深化的转变：从管理产出转向赋能创造性构建者，组织更扁平、代码所有权更模糊，并以结果而非产出指标衡量。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并非显而易见，坚持把模型部署到真实世界，通过持续迭代与公众反馈来推进对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 同年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，必须以负责任方式开发，安全研究要在公开环境中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Saying no to good ideas and focusing on the most important problem remains a constant discipline.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终主张对好想法说不、聚焦最重要的问题，这一主线贯穿其职业选择与产品判断。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型，主张人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制，让 AI 成为扩展思考的工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 她进一步深化：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，长期进步的关键是尽可能久地让人类留在回路中，而非移除人类。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values come from RLHF, not the model itself.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是经由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入的。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant UI and AI as instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式产品需要容错界面，AI 生成音乐应被看作乐器而非赝品，真正独特反而更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs, and watch inference marginal cost reshape business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：企业须重建基础设施、用 API 与 MCP 开放数据；AI 推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，大公司当前收益被高估。

gustav.en: Innovation comes from good explanations, not pattern recognition; Spotify prototypes and stack-ranks bets to synchronize the company.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调创新来自好的解释而非模式识别，解释必须难以被随意改动；Spotify 用原型与下注排序让全公司同步，并把自己当作音乐产业的研发部门。

gustav.en: No single org model; pick one fitting your personality. Use AI to give users control, not addiction, and optimize for time well spent.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，要选契合自身性格的那一种；用生成式 AI 把控制权交还用户而非让人上瘾，战略目标是“时间花得值”，同步游泳优于分而治之。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach reliable math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠对非形式化模型做 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现可靠的数学 AI；形式化验证对可靠证明不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation beats informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了放大卓越，而非仅仅消除错误；经过验证的生成在性能与样本效率上胜过非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine weaves prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base via auto-formalization.
carinahong.zh: 一个自我改进的推理引擎通过自动形式化把证明器、猜想器与知识库编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Lean-based systems excel in structured algebra but struggle in creative combinatorics; human taste still matters.
carinahong.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在结构化代数中表现出色，却在创造性的组合数学中吃力；人类品味依然重要。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is a major bottleneck; formal verification should serve open collaboration, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应服务于开放协作，而不只是安全攸关的细分领域。

mensch.en: Small models plus data quality can beat brute scaling; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他强调小模型加数据质量可胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），开源通过广泛审视带来安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality rival compute; value accrues at the application layer, not foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化为效率与数据质量可与算力并重，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: Sovereign, decentralized AI should augment jobs; governments must embrace experimentation, not fear.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与去中心化 AI，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱实验而非回避风险。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation is vertical fine-tuning, enterprise engagement, and agentic replatforming.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调、企业深度参与与智能体式平台重构。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建立战略自主，并称 AGI（通用人工智能）是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics hinge on memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency for cost, and context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学取决于内存带宽而非算力；批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: AI chips are fundamentally matrix multiply engines; data movement dominates compute costs, and low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片本质是矩阵乘法引擎；数据移动成本主导算力成本，低精度带来二次方效率提升。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为 iPod 标志着苹果从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要意愿与决心，而非天生特质。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; most LoveFrom work addresses the climate crisis.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他坚持虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，并称 LoveFrom 多数工作直接或间接应对气候危机。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他把设计进一步深化为由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是表达本质，且必须包含喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity beats fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验胜过伪造的引擎声。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox provides safety and security.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are easy to create as markdown files, enabling hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能可以轻松创建为 markdown 文件，实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding what to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解可以问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; don't supervise Claude closely, judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当你不完全知道自己要问什么时使用 Opus；不要密切监督 Claude，只根据最终影响来判断。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么；使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training RL yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律依然有效，但认为推理模型和后训练强化学习能在同等算力下带来更多收益，因此“AI 放缓”的说法是错的。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation and deployment economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动业界转向更小、更便宜的模型；拖慢预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的是蒸馏与部署经济性，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; frontier models still fail simple tasks, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域极强、邻近领域很差；前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，因此泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，却仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks outweigh existential ones.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差、需要谨慎监督；编码智能体可提升 5-10 倍生产力；相比存在性风险，系统被黑等近期风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—remains the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，预训练模仿加后训练强化学习的两阶段训练始终是核心主线。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new axis.
oriol.zh: 预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需要算法创新，推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but demand exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the video GPT moment has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models see humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时又能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike.
askell.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式规则，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine good judgment; transparency about values is crucial.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害良好判断；价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; designers should trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师花更少时间做原型，帮助工程师执行，并通过快速交付建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers.
jennywen.zh: 三种原型出现：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption, wait six months before new tools, and keep work and users at the center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师控制 AI 的采用，等待六个月再使用新工具，并将工作和用户置于中心，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Craft, attention to detail, and intuition remain crucial; designers should trust themselves over any process.
jennywen.zh: 手艺、对细节的关注和直觉始终至关重要；设计师应信任自己而非任何流程。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR, with verifiable rewards driving reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从数据质量胜过算法，深化到后训练三阶段（SFT、DPO、可验证奖励的强化学习），并强调 RLVR 带来思维链等推理行为。

lambert.en: Post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods; RLVR overoptimizes, and open models win on personalization.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张后训练把复杂产业配方压缩为可复现开源方法；RLVR 会过度优化，开放模型或在个性化与角色训练上取胜。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；RLVR 是最大突破。

lambert.en: Open models lag frontier by 6-9 months, driven by Chinese labs; they power sovereign AI and the next decade of research.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为开放模型落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，由中国实验室推动，是主权 AI 与未来十年研究的引擎，但长期可持续性存疑。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning. Vision suffices for driving; extra sensors are liabilities.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学式；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习。视觉足以支撑驾驶，额外传感器反而是负担。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy prevents collapse. Tesla's end-to-end is right; cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但熵能防止模型崩溃。特斯拉的端到端路线正确；认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory. LLMs are new OS with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 2.0 迈向软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存。LLM 是新操作系统，有类人心理；这是智能体的十年，要把 AI 拴在皮带上。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses. Agents need a decade to overcome continual learning and multimodality deficits.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃。智能体需要十年克服持续学习与多模态缺陷。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code; bottleneck is directing agents. Vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality; outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我没写过代码；瓶颈是指导智能体的技能。氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住质量；可外包思考，不可外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key, with sim-to-real transfer often relying on hidden engineering.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，强调无目标的好奇心驱动探索与样本高效的强化学习，并指出模拟到现实的迁移常依赖隐藏工程。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; unlike language, there is no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人本质上是数据问题；与语言不同，没有互联网规模的机器人数据，因此必须利用多样数据源并构建数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（类似语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人；预训练于视频和模拟数据、后训练于真实世界数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it requires rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题；需要严格测试，不能像软件那样快速扩展。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; timelines for home robots are highly uncertain, and progress surprises even experts.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他指出与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功；家用机器人的时间线高度不确定，进展甚至让专家感到意外。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; interpretability is now solved, and scaling current approaches suffices for autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，可解释性已可通过现代工具解决，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only reaches human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型能实现推理与涌现的安全行为；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化语言集成对表征、推理和个性化的提升，并强调通过课程学习和合成数据实现数据效率。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型，且基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他提出搭载内置传感器的大众市场车辆将在规模上超越 Robotaxi，并认为无需先验数据即可实现 500 多个城市的零样本泛化。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是真正推动 AI 进步的引擎；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no one model to rule them all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment grows more critical as models hallucinate; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 随着模型产生幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；安全必须优先于准确，而遗漏是重大风险。

edwinchen.en: AI can revolutionize clinical workflow by summarizing records, but using it to avoid struggle undermines learning.
edwinchen.zh: AI 能通过总结病历革新临床工作流，但用它来逃避思考会削弱学习。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing alignment risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他仍把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时让对齐风险更早暴露。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and capability needs now guarantee safety progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，并认为如今安全进展已由能力需求而非单纯伦理来保证。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把自动化 AI 研究视为重大里程碑，指出能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准滞后，并认为 AGI 一词正变得无意义。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is sufficient, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向以持续学习为核心目标，主张通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；并反共识地认为仅靠强化学习已足够，专门做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability, and models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他深化对齐思路，把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性，并预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and the goal is AI that creates new knowledge.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，终极目标是能创造新知识的 AI。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; by 2026 he stresses AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenges.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容始终关键；到 2026 年他强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy gaps, and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了历史遗留差距，本地语言模型能变革教育。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future—it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他直言 ChatGPT 的成功是意外，聊天不是终点，它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows；界面会超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and let emergent properties meet real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代、每日发布，让涌现能力在真实反馈中成长。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions—amplifying, not replacing, humans.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的愿景一以贯之：打造懂你目标、有上下文、能行动的个性化 AI 助手，放大而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements; next billion need proactive, affordance-rich products.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：北极星是长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品与模型改进各占三分之一；下一个十亿用户需要主动式、有可供性的产品。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision, not an afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司先要活下来，从简单产品起步证明自己，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond it, while phones become proactive, agentic, generative UI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件；同时手机的未来在于主动式、智能体式的生成式 UI，而非硬件大改。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is BS, so focus on applied AI and user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求，应聚焦应用型 AI 与用户痛点，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化为：成熟品类中设计是最快差异化手段；AI 让手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Consistent mainline: make tech fun, empower creatives, use marketing arbitrage, and stay humble through community.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：让科技有趣、赋能创作者、善用营销套利，并通过社区保持谦逊。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的接地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主体。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真对具身智能体的价值——可大规模并行、安全探索；并坚持简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从「具身为何重要」深化为「数据从哪来」：数据问题成为机器人学的主要瓶颈，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one control stays hardest, and the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张用简单端到端模型整合多源数据来构建机器人基础模型；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，而家用因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期，连同技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Design tools from the 90s (layers panel) are legacy; the future is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代的设计工具（图层面板）已是遗留产物；未来工具可互操作，代码即真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小规模设计师与工程师团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是基本要求；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“入职”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而微调可能随长上下文与自适应算力而变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bar—not raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的真正门槛是可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量，而非单纯的原始能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持编码是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域，世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil and the bottleneck; the future of work is managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他判断算力是新的石油与当前瓶颈，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体集群、在更高抽象层级上运作。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，沿用熟悉模式以求速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；并非每个界面都要完美，应按 ROI 决定何处做精。

henrymodisett.en: Brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for designer expression; AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing tech.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他提出品牌规范应是设计师表达的平台；AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使技术商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须说清设计为何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative recruits talent; avoid structured crits, prefer organic feedback; gut often beats data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈；在快增长创业中直觉常胜过数据。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测与人类学习存在根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and high-quality data can match or beat larger ones; language remains the best medium for reasoning.
yejin.zh: 借助更好的推理算法与高质量数据，更小的模型也能匹敌甚至超越大模型；语言仍是推理的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning; open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调；要对抗闭源前沿模型实验室，必须依靠开放研究与跨机构协作。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet, and RL during pre-training yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 凭借多样化的合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；多元对齐优于试图消除互联网偏见，而在预训练阶段引入强化学习能带来持久的推理提升。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为编程将从代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed and cost, contrary to his earlier expectation of relying on frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得不可或缺，这与他早先依赖前沿模型的预期相反。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, and by 2025 inference-time compute scaling becomes the major near-term lever.
shazeer.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；到 2025 年，推理阶段的算力扩张成为近期最重要的杠杆。

shazeer.en: Longer context windows, modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts, and continual learning replace monolithic retraining for efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 更长的上下文窗口、混合专家等模块化稀疏架构，以及持续学习，取代单体式重训练，实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Safety shifts from vague worry to engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding capabilities; models should learn by acting in the world.
shazeer.zh: 安全从模糊担忧转向工程保障、人类监督与理解模型能力；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress but not AGI alone; agentic behavior, coding, and open-source closing the frontier gap are underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式行为、编程以及开源缩小与前沿模型差距都被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning give strong learning signal.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的立场深化为：先验知识应用于数据生成与增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability to create real value; a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他判断仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Human brain generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may transfer better than one precise simulator.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真集成可能比单一精确模拟器更利于现实迁移。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and alignment plus robustness matter as capabilities grow.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align next-generation models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation is easier than generation, but the real risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
leike.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化出一个反共识判断：对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估天然比生成简单，但最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统究竟有多对齐。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; the superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broke, so post-training alone cannot align AGI or superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化：超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现，并强调仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）或超级智能。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are now necessary; even imperfect containment can raise misuse costs and buy time.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他从早期偏重技术研究转向主张第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管，并认为即便遏制不完美，也能抬高滥用成本、争取时间。
